narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -2.35 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.001038-0.001052 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.001130; the first objective pays 1.01R at 0.001014.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.001130 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.01 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 39/100 — trend broken, ask-wall ceiling, funding crowded
